🛑 Agent blocked: This card is pointed at the wrong repo, and the thing it asks for cannot be
built here.

The evidence. The card names one file to change, the Linear budget table
(`check_linear_budget.py`), and states it was split out of DRE-3236 "because it
lives in a different repo from the two spend cuts (agent-bureau's toolkit, not
bureau-pipeline)". That premise is backwards. The file and its tests exist only
in **bureau-pipeline** — `scripts/check_linear_budget.py` and
`tests/test_check_linear_budget.py` there — and nothing in agent-bureau references them:
a search of this whole checkout for `check_linear_budget` returns zero hits
outside the read-only pipeline checkout the run mounts. agent-bureau's
`scripts/` has no budget script at all.

The board says the same. DRE-3202, the card that CREATED this script, carries
`repo:bureau-pipeline`. DRE-3236, the card this one was split out of, carries
`repo:bureau-pipeline`. Both are children of DRE-3168. DRE-3242 alone carries
`repo:agent-bureau`, and that label is what routed this run here.

Why I did not just build it anyway. The only way to satisfy the card inside
agent-bureau is to create a second copy of a fleet sweep whose producer
(`linear_ops.budget_line`) and whose `config/repo-map.json` both live in
bureau-pipeline. A per-repo copy of a shared script is the drift the standards
exist to prevent, and it would leave the real table — the one the operator
actually runs — still dropping runs whose log is not yet retrievable. The
card's own acceptance criteria could never be met by the copy.

The fix is one label. Change `repo:agent-bureau` to `repo:bureau-pipeline` on
this card and return it to Todo; it then dispatches into the repo where the
file is, and the work is exactly as the card describes it — bounded, XS, and
unchanged in every other respect. Nothing about the requested behaviour is
wrong: retry a run whose log GitHub has not yet made retrievable, and name in
the footer any run still unreadable after the retries.

No PR was opened and no code was written. — parked in Backlog until the blocker is resolved (a Todo return here would redispatch agents into the same wall). Run: https://github.com/dreadnought-foundry/agent-bureau/actions/runs/34310166200

🛑 Agent blocked: This card was sent to the wrong repository, so it cannot be built from this run.

The work is a change to the hourly Linear budget table. That script and its tests exist only in the bureau-pipeline repository. This run was dispatched into agent-bureau, which has no copy of the script, and the credentials this run holds cannot read or push to bureau-pipeline. Building a stand-in copy here would be wrong, because nothing in agent-bureau uses it.

The cause was the card's routing label. It still said agent-bureau, the same defect that parked this card on 2026-09-08. Planning rewrote the description on 2026-10-06 but left the label as it was. I have now changed the label to bureau-pipeline, which matches the two cards this one came from (DRE-3202 and DRE-3236). No other label changed.

Nothing else is wrong with the card. It is clear, small, and buildable as written. Moving it back to Todo should send the next build to bureau-pipeline, where it can be done in one pull request. — parked in Backlog until the blocker is resolved (a Todo return here would redispatch agents into the same wall).
